## Production Enterprise Applications & Systems Built
1. **Enterprise HRMS & Automated Payroll (hr.solidrix.com):** Multi-tenant SaaS workforce portal supporting biometric attendance sync, automated PF/ESI/TDS statutory tax calculations, leave matrices, and bank transfer file exports.
2. **SKLOPS School ERP (sklops.com):** Comprehensive EdTech management platform covering online fee collection with payment gateway integration, parent notification portals, student grade sheets, and automated timetable scheduling.
3. **Vedant Billing & Retail POS (vedantbilling.com):** Fast offline-first retail POS software featuring instant barcode scanning under 5ms, thermal receipt printing, and background multi-store inventory synchronization.
4. **Solidrix Send Email Router (send.solidrix.com):** Multi-SMTP transactional email routing engine with real-time health checks, dynamic failover across tier-1 providers, and delivery webhook callbacks.
5. **Solidrix SMM Marketing Panel (smm.solidrix.com):** Order management portal with automated provider API synchronization and real-time wallet reconciliation.
